title: Pricing Rules
description: Automate price adjustments by segment or product.

help.title: About Pricing Rules
help.overview: Pricing rules change a line's unit price automatically, before any discount code. Use them for wholesale prices, category sales, or surcharges. Each cart line receives at most one rule. Name, type, value, and scope are required.

sections.title: Which rule wins
sections.body: Active rules are ordered by priority (highest first), then newest first. For each line, the first rule that qualifies and matches is applied; the rest are skipped for that line.
items: A rule outside its start and end dates is ignored.
Customer groups: a rule with none applies to everyone; a rule with groups applies only to signed-in customers in one of them. Guests match only rules with no groups.
Minimum order amount is checked against the cart subtotal before any rule; minimum quantity against the total units in the cart.

sections.title: Scope
items: All and customer group hit every line of a qualifying cart.
Product, category, and collection hit only the selected targets. Category looks only at the product's first category.

sections.title: Types
sections.body: The adjustment is applied to the catalog unit price, and the result is never below zero.
items: Percentage discount reduces the price by that percent. Fixed discount subtracts the value.
Fixed price replaces the price with the value. Surcharge adds the value.

sections.title: Where it applies
items: The cart re-prices from the catalog price every time, so a rule is never applied on top of an already-adjusted price.
Each line shows the rule that changed it. The till uses catalog prices and does not apply pricing rules.
Activate and deactivate switch the rule on and off. Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.
